Embarrassing Experiences
By Jack Preston
Last week, Student Times reporter Jack Preston asked students, “What’s the most
embarrassing experience you've ever had?” Here are five of his favorite responses.
This happened at work a few years ago. | was on an elevator, and a man got on that | didn't
know. He asked, “How are you?" | answered, “Pretty good.” Then he asked, “What's new?” and
I said, "Nothing much." Finally, he turned and said,"Do you mind?" He was on his cell phone! I
was so embarrassed!-susan
| sing all the time. One time, a few years ago, | was singing in the shower when my sister came
into the bathroom and recorded me! Later, we were driving, and my sister put on some music.
It was me! I was really embarrassed and turned bright red. - Becky
| fell asleep in math class once. | closed my eyes for a second, and the next thing | remember is
my teacher's voice. He was asking me a question. When | didn't answer, he walked over to my
desk. He asked the question again.-Alex
My friend's parents had a birthday party for her at their new house last year. They had these
glass doors that went out to the backyard. We were all outside, and | had to use the restroom.
So | was running to the house and then —- BAM! | hit the glass doors. | was really confused for a
minute. | thought they were open, but they were closed! [_]- Anita
When | was in middle school, | bought this cool new sweater. | wore it to a school dance the
next evening, and everyone laughed at me when | came in. The sweater was inside out! So |
went into the restroom to change and came back out.{_] Everyone laughed at me again. - Evan
